concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-method-update-node]] - Node.js stored-payment-method updates by token, including shared or replacement billing-address behavior, PayPal/default-method restrictions, conditional card verification, and nonce-association and precedence rules
warnings: Keep the source payment-method-wide while preserving which behaviors are credit-card-only or PayPal-only; do not generalize card verification, nonce mixing, or PayPal token updates to every payment-method type.
Preserve the shared-address effect of updateExisting and the omission behavior that creates a new address while leaving the old address in the customer's Vault.

Do not reconstruct the damaged destination after default_payment_method_token for other payment-method types; retain the explicit credit-card/PayPal limitation and the verified customer-update recommendation.
Do not imply that validations equal verification, that verification is always performed, or that a nonce associated with a customer is acceptable for this update operation.
